scope: expansion-0111 through expansion-0115, 80 page illustrations plus 5 covers

visualReview.coverage: Every cover and page inspected in five 3-column contact sheets, then all five revised sheets viewed again. Additional corrected 0111 and 0112 sheets re-inspected. Full-size pages checked: 0112 p03, 0114 p13, 0115 p12. Final 0112 p03 hand correction and its contact sheet inspected again.
corrections: 0111: traveler remains inside the illustrated book; added crouching and seated poses; held books and borrowing card connected to characters; lowered carts; removed a misleading intact path across the river; kept actual crossing at p13; two soup bowls and socks retained.

0112: one actual memory-clay form at a time; boot → spoon → fish → bowl → whale sequence appears only as diagrams on the paper strip; connected the pressing arm and visible fingertip to the gold dot; moved reflection to floor puddle; added three umbrella-carrying children behind window.

0113: scenes appear only during spoken reading, with open mouth and sound strokes; writing-only drafts remain on paper and projections disappear when reading stops; connected pencil to writing hand; moved reader beside table; kept ending at night and continuation separately attributed.

0114: amber eyes and three red maple leaves remain consistent on lion and quilt; moved red leaf off face; corrected floating toolbox/cart positions; girl rests beside quilt; rolled quilt retains visible eyes and leaves and fits cart.

0115: low rain platform below whale terrace and above storage stalls; girl sits on dry edge at p10; umbrella shafts avoid faces; p13 umbrella folded after rain; obstructing building hides actual whales and only shadow appears; returning cloud has round core and farewell strand reaches hand.
visualReview.limits: Simplified original vector picture-book illustrations. Visual checks cover composition, continuity, relevant props and overlaps. Does not certify bitmap painting, audio quality, browser layout, deployment or child-user testing.
